summary: Executed policy2 backend proxy regression and real-browser long-preview checks. Backend policy2 behavior passed end-to-end (long 720 now proxied, reuse confirmed, short 720 still skipped, 401 enforced). Frontend long-preview regression script reached real import/proxy and decoder seek checks but failed on scrub catch-up assertions (no frame surfaced through drawPreview/wcScrub path in this run).

integration_issues.flow: Long-video scrub catch-up (drawPreview/curTime after backward + small forward seeks, including post-pause)
integration_issues.issue: Regression script consistently observed null wcScrub.cur/frameTs and unchanged preview pixels at targets ~89.4/89.5/90.45 (+post 3s pause), failing async scrub catch-up assertion.

integration_issues.flow: Studio route targeting for true end-user path
integration_issues.issue: Actual user flow runs editor inside iframe on /studio?project=... -> /studio.html?...#/edit/... . Direct /studio.html probing can diverge from top-level route behavior and should be included in final regression pass.

issues: Missing-clips modal can block regression interactions and should expose deterministic test hooks/state bypass for QA runs.

action_items: Fix/confirm scrub async catch-up path so drawPreview eventually yields fresh frame timestamps after backward/small-forward seeks and after >3s pause.
Run final frontend regression through real /studio?project=... iframe flow and assert proxy-call order + playback/scrub metrics there.
Add a deterministic QA mode for missing-clips overlay handling to avoid modal-related test nondeterminism.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.html remains very large (~6k+ lines), making targeted media-pipeline regressions fragile and hard to isolate.
Regression logic spanning parse, playback, scrub, and proxy would benefit from smaller exported test harness functions instead of ad-hoc global state poking.
seed_data_creation: Generated short regression asset /tmp/beatcut_long_assets/h264_short_1280x720_20s.mp4 for short-720 retention test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend policy2 regression is green (6/6) with JUnit in iter33_long_proxy_policy2.xml. Frontend script /app/frontend/tests/test_long_preview_regression_iter33.py currently fails at scrub assertions (frameTs null). Avoid repeating the same scrub selector loop; pivot to iframe (/studio?project=...) execution context and validate drawPreview/wcScrub timing there. Firefox binary is unavailable in this container (which firefox -> not found).
rca of the issue: Observed scrub failure suggests preview scrub pipeline did not surface decoded frame to wcScrub.cur in this execution path, despite source/proxy seek and EOF checks passing. Reproduction: run python /app/frontend/tests/test_long_preview_regression_iter33.py, failure at scrub assertion with targets around 90s and post-pause small forward seek. Mitigation: execute scrub validation in real iframe editor route, instrument wcScrub lifecycle (seek/frameAt/redraw timer) and verify active plan/time alignment before asserting canvas/frame timestamp changes.
